cases.explain: The preposition для (for) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Господи, я услышал весть о Тебе, и я устрашен Твоими ___.
cases.explain: The instrumental case without a preposition expresses the cause of an emotional state.

cases.sentence: Бог пришел из Тимана, святой от горы ___.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Небеса покрылись его величием, и наполнилась земля его ___.
cases.explain: The instrumental case follows the verb наполнилась (was filled) to indicate what fills something.

cases.sentence: Его сияние, как солнечный свет, лучи исходят из его ___.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from within) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Болезнь идет перед ним, мор по его ___.
cases.explain: The preposition по (along, following) with the dative case shows following along someone's path.
The direct object of the transitive verb сотряс (shook) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Даже если инжир не расцветет и не будет винограда на ___.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with the prepositional case indicates location on something.

reading.ru: Молитва пророка Аввакума для пения Господи, я услышал весть о Тебе, и я устрашен Твоими делами.
reading.question: What emotion does Habakkuk experience when he hears about God?
options: He stands in awe of God's deeds
reading.correct: He stands in awe of God's deeds
reading.explain: Habakkuk says 'I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, Yahweh.'

reading.ru: Его сияние, как солнечный свет, лучи исходят из его рук, где скрыта его сила.
reading.question: What is compared to sunlight?
reading.explain: The text says 'His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand.'

reading.ru: Болезнь идет перед ним, мор по его стопам.
reading.question: What follows God's approach?
reading.explain: The text states 'Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.'

reading.ru: Ты прошел по земле в гневе, и в ярости ты уничтожил народы.
reading.question: What does God do to the nations?
options: Destroys them in anger and wrath
reading.correct: Destroys them in anger and wrath
reading.explain: The verse says 'You marched through the land in wrath. You threshed the nations in anger.'

reading.ru: Однако я буду терпеливо ждать дня расплаты для наших завоевателей.
reading.question: What will Habakkuk do despite the troubles?
options: Patiently wait for the day of judgment on their oppressors
reading.correct: Patiently wait for the day of judgment on their oppressors
reading.explain: The prophet says 'I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.'

reading.ru: Я все равно буду радоваться Господу и ликовать о Боге, моем Спасителе.
reading.question: How will Habakkuk respond to God?
options: Rejoice in the Lord and be joyful in God his Savior
reading.correct: Rejoice in the Lord and be joyful in God his Savior
reading.explain: The prophet declares 'Yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!'
